name: 5'-nucleotidase, cytosolic IIIA

function.text: NT5C3A is the approved symbol for 5'-nucleotidase, cytosolic IIIA. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in 5'-nucleotidase activity; magnesium ion binding; CMP catabolic process.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include hemolytic anemia due to pyrimidine 5' nucleotidase deficiency (autosomal recessive). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Adrenocortical carcinoma; Breast carcinoma; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: gbc. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: NT5C3A encodes 5'-nucleotidase, cytosolic IIIA. Its functions include 5'-nucleotidase activity and magnesium ion binding.

germline.text: Germline disease associations include hemolytic anemia due to pyrimidine 5' nucleotidase deficiency (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving NT5C3A have been reported in breast carcinoma, adrenocortical carcinoma, and hepatocellular carcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
